sections.title: Sound of W
paragraphs: You call this letter (W) /dʌbəl.juː/. Its main sound is in (wet) /wɛt/, which means not dry. This letter makes two sounds in English words.

sections.title: How to say W
paragraphs: Round your lips tightly into a small circle. Pull the back of your tongue up near the soft roof of your mouth. Turn on your voice and push air out smoothly as your lips open. Touch your throat with your hand to feel the vibration. The second sound has no movement because the mouth stays silent.

sections.title: Spelling of W
paragraphs: Before a vowel letter, this letter sounds like (win) /wɪn/. Before the letter r, this letter is a silent letter, as in (write) /raɪt/. A silent letter is a letter that you write but do not say. In a few special words like (two) /tuː/, it is also silent.

sections.title: Mistakes to avoid with W
paragraphs: Do not touch your upper teeth with your lower lip. That mistake makes the sound of the letter v instead. Keep your teeth completely away from your lips. Push both lips forward like a small whistle before you start to speak.
